title: Energy stocks lift SandP, Dow; Apple drags
text: Energy stocks lift S&P, Dow; Apple drags Monday, 5 November 2018 ( 39 minutes ago ) The S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose on Monday, supported by energy stocks and strong results from Berkshire Hathaway Inc, while a 3 percent drop in Apple Inc shares dragged down the Nasdaq. ▶ Tech Losses Snap Rally On Wall Street 00:33 According to Reuters, US stocks snapped a three-day rally on Wall Street. By the closing bell on Nov. 2nd, the top three markets on the New York Stock Exchange were in the red. The Dow Jones Industrial Average shed about 111-points, falling four-tenths of a percent.
